visual_requirements.description: powerful mature man, one head two arms two legs, lion pelt with lion-head hood over fully opaque robe and golden breastplate, knotted wooden club, quiver
Immense physical strength, club crashes into rock producing chips and dust; no magic emission
rough Nemean rock terrain, staging of the Nemean club and lion-pelt tradition

source_claims.quote: Hercules strangled the lion with his bare hands and forever after wore its pelt as a protective cloak.

statement.id: Herakles mencekik Singa Nemea dan mengenakan kulitnya.
statement.en: Heracles strangled the Nemean Lion and wore its pelt.

source_claims.quote: In ancient Greek Archaic and Classical pottery art Hercules is often depicted carrying a knotted club, a quiver full of arrows, and wearing a lion's pelt with sometimes also a lion's head helmet.

statement.id: Dalam seni tembikar Yunani Arkais dan Klasik, Herakles sering digambarkan membawa gada berbuku, wadah anak panah, dan mengenakan kulit singa, kadang dengan helm berkepala singa.
statement.en: In Archaic and Classical Greek pottery, Heracles is often shown carrying a knotted club and a quiver of arrows and wearing a lion pelt, sometimes with a lion-head helmet.

source_claims.quote: Hercules received a sword from Hermes, a bow and arrows from Apollo ... a golden breastplate from Hephaestus, and a robe from Athena; for he had himself cut a club at Nemea.

statement.id: Menurut Apollodorus, Herakles menerima pedang dari Hermes, busur dan anak panah dari Apollo, baju zirah emas dari Hephaestus, dan jubah dari Athena; gadanya ia potong sendiri di Nemea.
statement.en: According to Apollodorus, Heracles received a sword from Hermes, a bow and arrows from Apollo, a golden breastplate from Hephaestus, and a robe from Athena; he had cut his club himself at Nemea.

artistic_choices: Palette, camera, age details, opaque clothing embellishment and unspecific staging are editorial choices, not additional source facts.
Dominance through close framing and foreshortening unless source documents scale.
No outward power added beyond documented domain; weather, light and debris remain physically grounded.
